answer: Because the tide history dates every edge, the juniper audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 6 epochs of prior interaction to count. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, since the cipher edge has to exist before the case does. Verification alone takes 9 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
